title: Explicit quotient vertex of extension of scalars
statement: Let A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, C an A-algebra, pi:A\to B a surjective ring homomorphism, and I=ker(pi). Put Q=C/IC, where IC=I.map(A\to C). Define H:CommAlgCat(A)\to CommAlgCat(B) by the equivalence with rings under A, pushout along pi, and the inverse equivalence for B. There exists a B-algebra structure on Q and an isomorphism H(C)\cong Q in CommAlgCat(B).

proof.text: Put J = I.map(algebraMap A C) and q = Ideal.Quotient.mk J. The equality ker(pi) = I and Ideal.le_comap_map imply ker(pi) <= ker(q.comp(algebraMap A C)). Thus RingHom.liftOfSurjective constructs beta : B -> C/J descending this map.
Equip C/J with beta.toAlgebra. The equation beta.comp(pi) = q.comp(algebraMap A C) follows pointwise from RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply, including for zero ideals and zero quotient rings.

Apply the proved upstream Algebra.quotientBaseChangeObjIso with this B-algebra structure and composition equation. Its explicit pushout universal-property construction gives the required isomorphism in CommAlgCat(B). Package this isomorphism in Nonempty and pair it with beta.toAlgebra to obtain the existential statement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05WS, using the proved upstream quotientBaseChangeObjIso and elementary descent along pi

lean.statement:
noncomputable def quotientBaseChangeObjIso
    (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (I : Ideal A) (hker : RingHom.ker π = I)
    [Algebra B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))]
    (hcomp : (algebraMap B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))).comp π =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (algebraMap A C)) :
    (quotientBaseChange π).obj (CommAlgCat.of A C) ≅
      CommAlgCat.of B (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A C))

The action required by the unchanged existential node statement is constructed by RingHom.liftOfSurjective, because Ideal.le_comap_map shows that A -> C/IC kills ker(pi). Its composition equation is RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply. This construction followed by quotientBaseChangeObjIso proves the original statement; the complete server-compiled attachment check is in coord/reports/S1/Sheaf.RingTheory.SurjectiveQuotientBaseChange.md.
